requirements.missing: No fetched source provides a deterministic conversion from measured pre-harvest inputs (plant height, stem density, etc.) to estimated yield in t DM/ha or similar units. PEAQ (s10–s13) estimates RFV/NDF, not yield; s2 measures cut-plot yield post-harvest but gives no pre-harvest estimation formula.

While s13 (UMN Extension) and s10 (UW Madison) are university-affiliated and pre-harvest, they estimate relative feed value (RFV) and NDF, not dry-matter yield. s2 reports hand-cut plot DM yields (Mg ha⁻¹) but after harvest, not as a pre-harvest field-sampling estimator.
